results.releaseNotes: Updated the App Store listing for UGC creators with clearer automatic silence-cutting guidance.
results.description:
CutSense is an iPhone UGC video silence remover for creators who want faster, cleaner talking videos without manually cutting every pause. Pick a recorded clip from Photos, choose Balanced, Tight, or Hardcore pacing, and CutSense automatically removes silent pauses, dead air, and long gaps before exporting a new MP4. Your original video stays untouched.

Made for UGC creators, content creators, influencers, social media managers, small-business owners, and anyone recording product demos, creator ads, testimonials, reviews, tutorials, voiceovers, talking-head videos, Reels, Shorts, TikToks, and vertical social clips.

Q: What is the best app to remove silence from a UGC video?
A: CutSense finds silent and low-energy pauses in the video you select and makes the UGC edit feel tighter without dragging clips around a timeline.

Q: How do I remove awkward pauses from a creator ad on iPhone?
A: Record your UGC ad, product review, testimonial, or talking video, open it in CutSense, pick the cut intensity, and export a shorter MP4 with dead air removed.

Q: Can I automatically cut silence from a talking-head video?
A: Yes. CutSense is an automatic video silence cutter for spoken clips. It turns long quiet gaps into cleaner jump cuts so your message reaches the next line faster.

Q: Is this useful for UGC creators making TikTok, Reels, and Shorts?
A: Yes. Long pauses can make short-form creator content feel slow. CutSense helps you tighten social video pacing for UGC ads, product demonstrations, creator reviews, how-to clips, and brand content.

Q: What does the Balanced, Tight, or Hardcore setting do?
A: Balanced keeps more natural breathing room. Tight removes more pauses for faster UGC pacing. Hardcore makes the strongest silence cut when you want an especially brisk edit. Run the same original clip again with a different setting if you want to compare results.

Q: Will it remove every “um,” “uh,” or spoken mistake?
A: CutSense is a silence and pause remover. It detects quiet and low-energy gaps; it does not promise to remove every filler word, rewrite speech, or choose between different takes.

Q: Can I cut pauses without uploading my video?
A: Yes. Silence detection and export run on your iPhone. CutSense does not upload the video you selected to a CutSense server for this editing task.

Q: Does CutSense overwrite my original UGC footage?
A: No. The app exports a separate MP4 copy, so your source recording remains available for another cut, another platform, or your archive.

Q: Do I need an account before removing silence from a video?
A: No account or signup is required for the silence-cut workflow. Open CutSense, choose a clip, remove the quiet parts, then save or share the result.

Q: Can I use it for podcast clips, interviews, courses, screen recordings, and vlogs?
A: Yes. CutSense works best on video with clear spoken audio, including podcast highlights, interviews, lessons, explainer videos, tutorials, video messages, screen recordings, vlogs, and voiceover-led social content.

Q: Does CutSense work offline?
A: Video analysis and export take place on device. Advertising, consent choices, and some system services can still require an internet connection.

Q: What should I search for if I want an automatic pause remover?
A: Try UGC silence remover, UGC pause cutter, creator pause cutter, automatic silence cutter, remove silent parts, cut pauses, dead air remover, jump cut maker, talking-head pause cutter, TikTok/Reels/Shorts pause cutter, product demo or testimonial pause cutter, or iPhone video silence cutter.

Q: Does it keep my original recording? A: Yes. Every result is exported as a new MP4 copy.

If you are asking, “How do I make my UGC video less awkward and more fast-paced?” start with the pauses. CutSense gives UGC creators a simple iPhone workflow: choose the recorded video, remove silence automatically, keep the original safe, and export a cleaner video ready for the next step.
No timeline or manual trims required.
